name: Foreman Thazz'ril
summary: Peons work under Foreman Thazz'ril in the Valley of Trials. The orc labor supervisor keeps crews on schedule and supplies ready for young warriors, but slacking workers and nearby cultists frustrate him.

sections.title: Keeping the Peons in Line
sections.body: In the Valley of Trials, Foreman Thazz'ril directs peons who chop lumber and gather materials for the encampment and young warriors. Building a home in Durotar's harsh red rock takes steady labor, yet the peons often nap under the desert sun. Thazz'ril sends newly arrived recruits to rouse the sleepers with his blackjack, and keep construction moving.

sections.title: A Lost Pick in Dangerous Hands
sections.body: While scouting the Burning Blade Coven for mineral resources, Thazz'ril fled the dark cultists inside and accidentally left his treasured enchanted pick behind. Warlocks and their demonic minions now gather in the cave. Too cautious to retrieve the tool himself, Thazz'ril relies on young Horde aspirants to venture into the depths and bring it back.

faq.answer: Foreman Thazz'ril is an orc labor supervisor in the Valley of Trials in Durotar. He manages work crews, oversees lumber chopping, and surveys the region for resources to aid the Horde's settlement.

faq.q: Why does Thazz'ril give players a blackjack?
faq.answer: The peons under Thazz'ril's watch often sleep instead of gathering lumber. He gives recruits an enchanted wooden blackjack to rouse them and send them back to work.

faq.q: Why is Thazz'ril's pick inside the Burning Blade cave?
faq.answer: Thazz'ril left his enchanted pick in the Burning Blade Coven while scouting for mineral veins. He fled when he encountered the cultists inside.

faq.q: What is his role in the Horde?
faq.answer: Thazz'ril is a civilian overseer, not a frontline soldier or shaman. He supervises manual labor, maintains construction supplies, and keeps peons productive.

angles.text: As a young orc coming of age, you see how Horde strength on the battlefield depends on disciplined labor.
As a miner, you can see how much Thazz'ril values his equipment: he is desperate to recover his enchanted pick from the Burning Blade Coven.
